tokens.name: depth-0
tokens.usage: Raised: menus, the palette, text fields, the active source line. The shallowest ground; never used for whole panes.

tokens.name: depth-1
tokens.usage: Writing ground: the Source pane, the scholia margin, the Library catalogue. Where reading and writing happen.

tokens.name: depth-2
tokens.usage: Chrome: the headline, the rail, pane heads, tabs at rest, the status line.

tokens.name: depth-3
tokens.usage: Desk: the ground behind proof sheets and behind anything laid out as paper.

tokens.name: depth-4
tokens.usage: Well: the Apparatus and the raw log. The deepest ground; only `ink` and `ink-2` text, plus the three `-ink` signal colours.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the solid ink button, on every depth and on the three washes. Also the outline of menus and of the active siglum.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on every depth: metadata, inactive tabs, field labels, scholia bodies.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Quiet text on `depth-0` to `depth-3` only: line numbers, placeholders, braces, the diple of a plain note. Use `ink-2` in the well.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between panes, rows and ruler ticks. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that carry meaning: field and quiet-button outlines, idle sigla, switch tracks, the measure's long ticks. At least 3:1 on `depth-0` to `depth-4`.

tokens.name: bronze
tokens.usage: Asks. The fill of the one Compile button and of a siglum that needs attention. Fills only, always edged in `bronze-ink` and labelled in `on-bronze`; as text or a mark use `bronze-ink`.

tokens.name: bronze-ink
tokens.usage: Asks, as text or mark on every depth and on `bronze-wash`: the asterisk, warning scholia, commands in source, the caret, unsaved names. Also the edge of a `bronze` fill.

tokens.name: bronze-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of a source line that asks, and of the current search match. Text on it is `ink` or `bronze-ink`.

tokens.name: on-bronze
tokens.usage: Label and shortcut on a `bronze` fill. Dark in both themes.

tokens.name: patina
tokens.usage: Settled. The halmos, the on-state of a switch, a siglum whose module is in order. Fills and marks; as text use `patina-ink`.

tokens.name: patina-ink
tokens.usage: Settled, as text on every depth and on `patina-wash`: resolved references and citation keys, math, links, counsel scholia, the word beside a halmos.

tokens.name: patina-wash
tokens.usage: Selection in source and proof, and the ground of a counsel scholion on hover. Text on it is `ink` or `patina-ink`.

tokens.name: on-patina
tokens.usage: Text on a `patina` fill (a settled siglum).

tokens.name: cinnabar
tokens.usage: Broken. The fill of a destructive button once armed and of a siglum whose module fails. Fills only; as text or mark use `cinnabar-ink`.

tokens.name: cinnabar-ink
tokens.usage: Broken, as text or mark on every depth and on `cinnabar-wash`: the obelus, error scholia and their lemma underline, the danger button at rest.

tokens.name: cinnabar-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of the source line where compilation fails. Text on it is `ink` or `cinnabar-ink`.

tokens.name: on-cinnabar
tokens.usage: Label on a `cinnabar` fill.

tokens.name: proof-paper
tokens.usage: The sheet in the Proof pane. White by day; dimmed a step by lamplight so it does not glare.

tokens.name: proof-ink
tokens.usage: Typeset text on `proof-paper`, both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on any depth and around any fill. At least 3:1 on `depth-0` to `depth-4` in both themes.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected text in source and proof.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and cross-references; always underlined.

tokens.name: syntax-command
tokens.usage: Control sequences in source: `\section`, `\cite`, `\begin`.

tokens.name: syntax-math
tokens.usage: Math mode, delimiters included.

tokens.name: syntax-comment
tokens.usage: Comments. Set in the `voice-scholion` style, not in mono: a comment is counsel, not code.

tokens.name: syntax-brace
tokens.usage: Braces, brackets and other delimiters.

families.voice: "Gentium Book Plus", "Gentium Plus", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, "Book Antiqua", serif
families.source: Inconsolata, "DejaVu Sans Mono", Consolas, "Courier New", monospace

groups.name: Voice
groups.note: Gentium Book Plus, a scholar's serif. It names things and it speaks: titles, names, marks, margin notes. It never labels a control.

styles.name: voice-display
styles.usage: The wordmark at cover scale and the Library's empty state. Once per screen at most.

styles.name: voice-heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside a screen or a confirm strip.

styles.name: voice-name
styles.usage: The name of a thing: a project in the catalogue, a pane's title, the document in the headline.

styles.name: voice-prose
styles.sample: A project is a repository. OpenLeaf reads it, compiles it, and writes back only when you commit.
styles.usage: Running explanation: empty states, module descriptions, anything longer than a line.

styles.name: voice-scholion
styles.sample: file not found; did you mean fig-2.pdf?
styles.usage: Margin notes, comments in source, hints under fields. Italic, one 20px line per source line so notes sit beside what they gloss.

styles.name: voice-caps
styles.usage: Column heads and pane kinds. Lowercase text set with `font-variant-caps: all-small-caps` (the face carries true small caps); never typed in capitals.

groups.name: Control
groups.note: Commissioner, a quiet humanist sans. It labels what you can press, and nothing else.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, menu items, switch labels.

styles.name: control-quiet
styles.usage: Text typed into fields, menu descriptions, status-line words.

styles.name: control-strong
styles.usage: The one emphasised word in a control row; the active tab.

styles.name: control-label
styles.usage: Field labels and the words under rail sigla.

groups.name: Source
groups.note: Inconsolata, the monospace LaTeX users already load for listings. Its advance is exactly half an em, so 15px text sets 7.5px columns and the measure rule can be drawn in `ch`.

styles.name: source
styles.usage: LaTeX source. One 20px line per row; never wrapped tighter.

styles.name: source-strong
styles.usage: Environment names and the matched bracket.

styles.name: source-figure
styles.usage: Everything counted or addressed: line numbers, lemmas, paths, branches, shortcuts, page counts, times.

spacing.note: One unit: the 20px line that source, margin notes and controls all share. Steps are quarters of it. There is no 4 or 8.

tokens.name: space-hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines and the gap between abutting panes.

tokens.name: space-quarter
tokens.usage: Mark to word; siglum to title; vertical padding inside a 30px control.

tokens.name: space-half
tokens.usage: Between controls in a row; pane-head side padding; cell padding in the catalogue.

tokens.name: space-3q
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside buttons and tabs.

tokens.name: space-line
tokens.usage: The line. Row height of source, scholia and apparatus; gutter between text and margin; screen padding on small widths.

tokens.name: space-2line
tokens.usage: Headline and rail thickness; screen padding; the gap between proof sheets.

tokens.name: space-3line
tokens.usage: Catalogue row height; the line-number gutter.

tokens.name: space-4line
tokens.usage: Top of a screen to its title.

radius.note: Square. Things are cut, not moulded; the only softening is the nib.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Panes, sheets, tabs, rows, sigla, the well. The default.

tokens.name: radius-nib
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, switches, menus, keys: the things a hand touches.

measure.note: Widths are measures, set once and kept.

tokens.name: measure-source
tokens.usage: Width of the source column in `source` type (600px). The wrap mark sits at its right edge.

tokens.name: measure-margin
tokens.usage: Width of the scholia margin beside the source: 14 lines.

tokens.name: measure-gutter
tokens.usage: Line-number gutter, mark included.

tokens.name: measure-rail
tokens.usage: Width of the module rail and height of the headline.

tokens.name: measure-control
tokens.usage: Height of every button, field, tab and pane head: a line and a half.

tokens.name: measure-prose
tokens.usage: Longest line of `voice-prose`.
